mapper.select: SELECT competition.name AS title, judge.judge_code, judge.com_id, competition.review_begin_time AS start_date, competition.review_end_time AS end_date, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM judge AS j WHERE j.com_id = judge.com_id AND judge_code = #{code}) AS total_num, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM score WHERE com_id = judge.com_id AND judge_code = #{code}) AS completed_num FROM judge JOIN competition ON competition.id = judge.com_id WHERE judge_code = #{code} GROUP BY com_id

SELECT w.id, w.work_name AS title, s.score AS score, s.opinion AS opinion FROM work w LEFT JOIN score s ON s.com_id = w.com_id AND s.user_code = w.user_code AND s.judge_code = #{code} WHERE w.com_id = #{comId} AND w.user_code IN (SELECT user_code FROM judge WHERE com_id = #{comId} AND judge_code = #{code}) ORDER BY w.id DESC
SELECT score FROM score WHERE com_id = (SELECT com_id FROM work WHERE id = #{id}) AND judge_code = #{code} AND user_code = (SELECT user_code FROM work WHERE id = #{id})
SELECT opinion FROM score WHERE com_id = (SELECT com_id FROM work WHERE id = #{id}) AND judge_code = #{code} AND user_code = (SELECT user_code FROM work WHERE id = #{id})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO score (judge_code, user_code, com_id, score, opinion) VALUES (#{jCode}, #{uCode}, #{comId}, #{score}, #{opinion})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM judge WHERE user_code = (SELECT user_code FROM work WHERE id = #{id}) AND judge_code = #{code}

SELECT w.id AS work_id, s.user_code AS leader_code, u.name AS leader_name, d.name AS dep_name, w.schema_content, s.judge_code, s.score, s.opinion FROM score s JOIN work w ON w.com_id = s.com_id AND w.user_code = s.user_code JOIN user u ON u.code = s.user_code LEFT JOIN department d ON d.id = u.dep_id WHERE s.com_id = #{comId} ORDER BY w.id DESC, s.user_code, s.judge_code
